description: A5b K=2 5-seed TTA ensemble. 4 audio augmentations + original = 5 versions per chunk; each forwarded through the existing 5 A2.5 head ckpts -> per-aug per-seed A2.5 logit -> K=2 fusion with un-augmented G4_gi + G5_modulation z-logits. Mean across 5 augs x 5 seeds = 25 fused logits per chunk. tau swept on train_threshold. Tests whether WavLM-substrate input perturbation reduces noise enough to lift the K=2 ensemble's 0.7090 toward 0.710 baseline. G4/G5 are NOT re-extracted because G4 is gain-invariant by design and G5 modulation is fairly robust to small temporal jitter (the cost-benefit doesn't justify re-extracting them).
